name: Pest Control
description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs, and the trophy unlocks [1][2]. The 39 operations are marked by yellow icons as you get near them, and the 100% checklist wants all 39 [1][2]. Track each gang under Progress > Gangs [1].
steps: Open Progress > Gangs to see which gang you still owe a hit [1].
Raid one yellow operation icon per gang [1][2].
The trophy pops when the ninth gang's operation falls [1][3].

name: In The Beginning…
description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
guide: Enjoy a cocktail with an Ocean Beach view and the trophy unlocks [1]. Head to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar [1][2]. The sources list no hard cutoff for the visit [1][2].
steps: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach [1][2].
Buy the Apple Martini specifically [1][2].
Drink it standing next to the bar; the trophy pops as you finish the glass [1][3].
window: If the bar visit is left for a later chapter it stays available, since no source marks a deadline [1][2]; to be safe against our one-chance flag, do it on the first evening you walk Ocean Beach after Chapter 3 [1].

name: Capital Offense
description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom and the trophy unlocks [1]. The car must be the blue Banshee in the south Vice City showroom, hacked with the Key Cloner from Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS [1][2]. Only this specific Banshee counts - it is a GTA III easter egg [1][2].
steps: Earn the Key Cloner in Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS [1][3].
Visit the showroom in the south of Vice City and hack the blue Banshee [1][2].
Drive forward through the showroom window and keep going down the street [1][2].
The pop is slightly delayed, landing once you are away from the store [1].

name: Let’s Go Bowling
description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
guide: Follow through at Kingpin Bowling and the trophy unlocks [1]. The alley is a gang operation in Port Gellhorn, marked during Chapter 2's optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, and you must lift all three key valuables - the luxury watch, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun and the safe loot [1][2]. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not on the third item [1].
steps: Buy sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, then take the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling [1][2].
Grab the luxury watch in the south-east office [1].
Grab the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun in the north-east corner [1].
Blow the safe in the north-east hallway and take its loot, then escape the police [1].
The trophy pops once the heat clears [1][3].
window: PowerPyx says the robbery icon respawns, so missing an item never locks the trophy [1][2]; our flag keeps it as a Chapter 2 window, so grab all three valuables on the first visit to be safe [1][2].

citations.title: GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
citations.snippet: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, a gang operation in Port Gellhorn; blow the safe with sticky bombs; the trophy pops after escaping police; respawns make it not missable.

name: Personal Best
guide: Reach maximum strength with both characters at the same time, and the trophy unlocks [1]. Train at any fitness club after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when the pair can go together [1][2]. While one character actively works out, the other trains automatically, doubling your progress [1].
steps: Finish Coffee Break to unlock partner free-roam [2].
Buy a fitness-club membership and check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia [1].
Train both characters to max, always bringing the partner along for double progress [1].
The trophy pops when both hit maximum strength [1][3].
window: No source marks a cutoff, since gyms stay open after the story [1]; to respect our one-chance flag, start joint gym sessions as soon as partner free-roam unlocks after Coffee Break [1][2].

name: Actions Speak Louder
guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile, and the trophy unlocks [1]. Every robbery, stealth clear, takedown and escape feeds the counter, and the trophy list shows your progress out of 500 [1]. Most players bank it passively while working the 100% checklist [1].
steps: Turn on Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile [1].
Play normally - robberies, clean escapes and combat all add actions [1].
If short at the end, farm by running over civilians and cops with a car [1].
The trophy pops at 500 actions [1][3].
window: The counter runs the whole game and nothing expires [1]; our flag treats the story run as the window, so keep profile notifications on and let every mission feed the 500 [1][2].

citations.title: GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
citations.snippet: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile; enable Criminal Profile notifications; farming via running over civilians works if still short.

name: Bad Luck, I Guess
guide: The trophy is the second time's-the-charm robbery of the Prologue's Payday Loans store [2]. Return as Lucia after Chapter 3's Credit Check, rob the same store in Vice City - Little Cuba and get away on foot, not in a vehicle [2]. The roadmap text page still lists the method as unconfirmed, but PowerPyx's own video guide spells out the full routine [1][2].
steps: Note the Payday Loans store Lucia robs during the Prologue [2].
Finish Chapter 3's Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock Payday Loans robberies [2].
As Lucia, alone, rob the same Little Cuba store again [2].
Escape on foot - a vehicle exit voids it - and the trophy pops [2][3].

name: The Truth Is Out There
guide: Complete the UFO easter egg and the trophy unlocks [1][2]. The spot is the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2:00 AM, and you must come solo [1][2]. The spawn is slightly random, so keep circling until the blinking car appears [1][2].
steps: At night after 2:00 AM, drive alone to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County [1][2].
If no blinking car is parked, drive away and return until one spawns [2].
Follow the path into the woods to the UFO and approach the blue light [1][2].
Talk to the abducted woman, walk her back to her car, and the trophy unlocks [1][2].
window: The trigger only appears at night after 2:00 AM, solo [1][2]; a no-show night never locks the trophy, but only a solo night visit at that road can fire it [1].

name: Ten Pin
description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
guide: Bowl over 10 pedestrians with melee drive-by kicks within 60 seconds, and the trophy unlocks [1][2]. Ride any motorcycle or push bike through a crowded strip and kick as you pass [1][2]. The counter resets if the 60-second window lapses, so keep the bike moving [1].
steps: Take a motorcycle or push bike to Ocean Beach or downtown Vice City [1][2].
Kick pedestrians with the melee button while riding past them [1][2].
Chain 10 knockdowns inside 60 seconds [1].
The trophy pops on the tenth knockdown [1][3].

name: Dime on the Dollar
description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts, and the trophy unlocks [1]. The Dye Pack Jammer from Chapter 3's Credit Check makes marked bills sellable, and fences take the cash with Yasmani paying the most [1][3]. The total is cumulative across all robberies, so no single $250,000 run is needed [1].
steps: Finish Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 [1][3].
Rob banks and Payday Loans to build up marked bills [1].
Sell the bills to a fence, preferring Yasmani in Vice City [1][2].
The trophy pops when the lifetime washed total crosses $250,000 [1][4].

name: Treat Yo Self

Mod cars at the 14 mod shops for the most expensive upgrades [1][2].
Top up with tattoos and clothing until the total passes $100,000 [1].
The trophy pops when cumulative spending crosses the line [1][3].

Fund the buys with robberies, which pay best from Chapters 3-4 [1].
Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the app [1][2].
The trophy pops when the eighth deed clears [1][3].

name: On the Spot
description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, and the trophy unlocks [1]. The app appears after Chapter 2's Moses mission, but registrations need garage parking spots, so buy garages first [1]. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then Respray and Register each one [1].
steps: Finish Chapter 2's Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses) to get the Scooter Bros app [1].
Buy garages so you hold at least 10 parking spots [1].
Drive stolen vehicles to Moses and pick Respray, then Register [1].
Cheap low-end cars keep the registration fees small; the trophy pops on the tenth [1][3].
